_note: KINETIC presenter clip library (owner spec 2026-07-12) — 60 traversal/physics moves choreographed to PowerPoint Morph. This is the CINEMATIC mode (distinct from the stationary professional Gestures Pack). Fetch each from Mixamo (Without Skin / In Place where noted / FBX Binary / 30fps / no keyframe reduction), stage in mocap/, then bake into the 100-clip master library. PP ceiling = 18 anims/model → each DECK bakes a custom 18-of-N via pygltflib. Some search terms are AI-suggested and may lack an exact Mixamo match → take the closest and record the ACTUAL take name in 'actual'. Dupes flagged.
